eligibility_rule: exact frozen inline main: season starts ixes > 200 and ixes < len(s)-300
seed_rule: SHA256 of pipe-separated master seed and scope; first 8 digest bytes big-endian
placement_rule: seeded permutation; greedily retain pairwise disjoint intervals; always reject historical-anchor overlap; never relax
station_aggregation: median of available seasonal-stratum medians; equal stratum weight
gas_aggregation: median across physical station summaries; CO2 and CH4 separate
pairwise_interval_scope: descriptive, not simultaneous familywise confidence bands
trend_workstream: CLOSED; old hourly diagnostic is HISTORICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY
